title: Refuse an approved review decision while a P1 finding stands unresolved
action: In reviews.rs the decision branch validates only the status enum, so approved records cleanly with open P1s. Add: when status is approved, collect findings whose severity is P1; if any exist, require decision.p1_resolutions to be an array naming every one of them (by finding id when present, else its index) with a non-empty cell id, and refuse otherwise - naming the open count and the FIX. Red-first: write the refusal test before the check exists.

truths: approved with an unresolved P1 is refused and names the count
approved with every P1 resolved to a cell succeeds
a blocked or pending decision is unaffected
